edits.after_comment: Partial analysis view of matrix-pointer stack storage. Initialized cursor at 0x4e0e88 points here. 0x472ef0/0x472f30 pre-increment the cursor by 4 and store a matrix pointer; 0x472ef0 also reads the previous slot, and 0x472f60 decrements by 4. Displayed two-element prefix is not the allocation extent. Original capacity is unresolved; a 128-byte gap does not prove 32 entries.

Partial analysis view of 32-bit matrix identity-flag stack storage. Initialized cursor at 0x4e0e84 points here. 0x472ef0 pre-increments by 4 and copies the previous flag; 0x472f30 writes zero to the new slot; 0x472f60 decrements by 4. Displayed two-element prefix is not the allocation extent. Original capacity is unresolved; a 128-byte gap does not prove 32 entries.

Triangle-index sequence, not one scalar record. Producer 0x46bfc0 computes base + count*12 and writes three dwords at 0x46c036/0x46c039/0x46c03c; consumer 0x46c070 advances 12 bytes. Displayed one-record prefix preserves element layout only. Capacity is unresolved: the next count at 0x53d750 does not by itself prove 1024 records.

Runtime turret-pointer sequence. 0x437c3a stores at base + count*4; 0x437dc0 walks runtime count with four-byte stride. Displayed one-element prefix is not the capacity. Neither 128 nor 129 is proven by these accesses; 0x4f41e8 remains unresolved storage before the independent napalm-template pointer at 0x4f41ec.
